incidents.name: HCT burn-and-sync pair drain
incidents.notes: HCT.burn() also destroys HCT held by the HCT/WBNB PancakeSwap pair, so a flash-loan buyer could burn down the pair's balance, call the permissionless sync() and sell back into the inflated reserves.
